models.folderTree: The hierarchical navigation structure showing Years containing Weeks containing Categories. Each node can be expanded/collapsed and shows item counts for leaf folders.
models.artifacts: Captured pieces of work consisting of a screenshot (.png) paired with an AI-generated markdown summary (.md) sharing the same base filename.
models.weeks: Temporal containers that group artifacts by category. Each week spans 7 days and forms a 'chapter' of the user's work history.
models.categories: Folders within a week that organize artifacts by type (Code, Terminal, Performance, Architecture, AI_Agents, etc.).

relationships: FolderTree contains Years, which contain Weeks, which contain Categories
Each Artifact belongs to exactly one Category within one Week
Artifacts have paired .png and .md files with the same base filename

artifacts.name: agent-orchestration-diagram
artifacts.title: Multi-Agent Orchestration Architecture
artifacts.markdownContent:
# Multi-Agent Orchestration Architecture

Architectural diagram showing how multiple AI agents coordinate to process different artifact types. The system uses a dispatcher pattern where incoming artifacts are routed to specialized agents based on content type.

## Agent Types
- **Screenshot Agent**: Analyzes visual content, extracts text via OCR, identifies UI patterns
- **Commit Agent**: Parses git diffs, summarizes code changes, links to related artifacts
- **Context Agent**: Builds narrative connections between artifacts within a week

## Data Flow
1. Artifact enters the system via automation trigger
2. Dispatcher determines artifact type
3. Specialized agent processes and generates summary
4. Context agent enriches with weekly narrative
5. Final artifact saved to folder structure
